## Task 1: Compute support, confidence, and lift by hand

Use the 5-transaction toy database from the lesson.

```{r task1-toy-data}
# Transaction database (as a list of character vectors)
trans_list <- list(
  T1 = c("dental", "vision"),
  T2 = c("dental", "mental"),
  T3 = c("dental", "vision", "mental"),
  T4 = c("vision", "mental"),
  T5 = c("dental", "vision")
)
N <- length(trans_list)

# Helper function: count how many transactions contain a given itemset
contains <- function(trans_list, itemset) {
  sum(sapply(trans_list, function(t) all(itemset %in% t)))
}
```

```{r task1-support}
# TODO: compute support of {dental}, {vision}, {mental}, {dental, vision}
supp_dental        <- NULL  # contains(...) / N
supp_vision        <- NULL
supp_mental        <- NULL
supp_dental_vision <- NULL

cat("supp({dental})        =", supp_dental, "\n")
cat("supp({vision})        =", supp_vision, "\n")
cat("supp({mental})        =", supp_mental, "\n")
cat("supp({dental, vision})=", supp_dental_vision, "\n")
```

```{r task1-confidence}
# TODO: compute confidence of dental → vision  and  vision → dental
conf_d_v <- NULL  # supp_dental_vision / supp_dental
conf_v_d <- NULL  # supp_dental_vision / supp_vision

cat("conf(dental → vision) =", conf_d_v, "\n")
cat("conf(vision → dental) =", conf_v_d, "\n")
```

```{r task1-lift}
# TODO: compute lift of dental → vision
lift_d_v <- NULL  # conf_d_v / supp_vision

cat("lift(dental → vision) =", lift_d_v, "\n")
# Is the association positive, negative, or independent? Write a comment.
# Answer:
```

## Task 2: Verify the anti-monotone property

```{r task2-antimonotone}
# Set min_supp = 0.60
min_supp <- 0.60

# TODO: compute support of {dental, mental}
supp_dental_mental <- NULL

# Is {dental, mental} infrequent (below min_supp)?
cat("supp({dental, mental}) =", supp_dental_mental, "— infrequent:", supp_dental_mental < min_supp, "\n")

# TODO: compute support of the superset {dental, vision, mental}
supp_all_three <- NULL
cat("supp({dental, vision, mental}) =", supp_all_three, "— also infrequent:", supp_all_three < min_supp, "\n")

# Comment: does the anti-monotone property hold here?
# Answer:
```
